# Severity Level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SeverityLevel`](gmeow-SeverityLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SeverityLevel>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

The graded severity of a cascade or hazard — an OPEN, ordered value vocabulary (catastrophic ≻ severe ≻ moderate ≻ minor; deployments add grades — negligible, critical, FMEA 1–10 bands — without schema change, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), the kernel [`GranularityLevel`](gmeow-GranularityLevel.md) pattern (fourth use). [`gmeow:moreSevereThan`](../properties/gmeow-moreSevereThan.md) is transitive ON LEVELS ONLY. Terminology anchored to ISO 31000 / IEC 60812 in docs, never axioms; what a grade DEMANDS in response is the norms extension's business, plugged in via [`Mitigation`](gmeow-Mitigation.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SeverityLevel`](gmeow-SeverityLevel.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
